title: enhanced golden apples.
description: This mod transforms apples into the enhanced golden apples.
body:
![golden apples](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6f246d96ba0723c1547bbf88e86c1548e5f0f63.png)

This modification transforms apples into upgraded golden apples and also includes a golden sword. This sword is crafted using gold plaques and wood. Efficiency 6, Enchantability 4, Attack Damage 5, Attack Speed ​​1.3
![sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e452041f81d52ec30e9989ed56544fce2535b5c.png)
